subject: Garin's Grave
text: The suggested level for Garin's Grave is 13.

evidence.quote: SUGGESTED LEVEL – 13

subject: Garin's Grave
text: Make sure to have a few Magic Keys on hand before entering Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote: Before you enter the grave, make sure to have a few Magic Keys on hand.

subject: Cursed Belt
text: The Cursed Belt can be found inside Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote: Now there is another good item in this dungeon other than the Silver Harp, which is the Cursed Belt.

subject: Curse Healer
text: If you happen to equip the Cursed Belt, a man in Brecconary will heal your curse.

evidence.quote: If you do happen to equip it, go see the man in Brecconary who'll heal your curse.

subject: Chest
text: From the entrance of Garin's Grave, go right and up to a huge intersection, then right to the wall, and all the way up and left to retrieve an Herb and some Gold.

evidence.quote: From the entrance, after casting Radiant, go right and then up until you come across a huge intersection, at which point you'll want to go right again until you hit the wall. Then go all the way up and left to retrieve the Herb, and some Gold.

subject: Garin's Grave 1F Stairs
text: From the Herb and Gold, go back right, all the way down, left through a locked magic door, and left to the stairs leading up.

evidence.quote: Then go back right and go all the way down until you can't go down anymore. At this point, go left and use a Magic Key on the door to get through. Then go all the way left and to the stairs. Go up.

subject: Garin's Grave 2F Stairs
text: On the second floor of Garin's Grave, ignore the first two staircases, head down, and descend the staircase there to reach the third floor.

evidence.quote: On the second floor, you'll come right up by a staircase, but ignore it for now. Go left and ignore the staircase there as well, and then go down and go down that staircase. You'll now be on the third floor.

subject: Silver Harp Chest
text: From the third floor stairs, go up to the wall, right and slightly down to descend another staircase, circle around the room, go down the stairs on the other side, and open the treasure chest to get the Silver Harp.

evidence.quote: From that staircase, just shoot up, keep going up until you can't go up anymore. Now you'll want to go right and down a tad and go down that staircase as well. Now just circle around this wide-open room, go down the stairs on the other side, and open the treasure chest to get the Silver Harp.

subject: Staff of Rain Chest
text: Northwest of Kol across a bridge and through a crack in the mountains, an old man in a dungeon disappears after speaking, leaving behind a chest with the Staff of Rain.

evidence.quote: There is a dungeon-door northwest of Kol, that's where we want to go. To get there, go across the bridge you'd cross eastward to get the Kol. Go up as if you were going to Kol, but slip through the little crack in the mountains west of Kol and follow the forested path upwards to the dungeon. Talk to the old man in there and he'll say that he's been waiting a long time for you, and that he thanks you and disappears. Open the chest he was guarding to get the Staff of Rain!

subject: Old Man in Kol
text: In the Village of Kol, an old man locked behind a magic door asks if you found the flute; answering 'yes' prompts him to direct you to Cantlin, while 'no' reveals Howard took it to Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: First off, go to the Village of Kol. No one has anything new to say here, but open the door with a Magic Key to the west of the village entrapping an old man and talk to him. He'll ask you, "Has thou found the flute?" If you answer "yes" then he'll tell you to, "Go to the town of Cantlin." If you answer "no" he'll tell you that, "Howard had it, but he went to Rimuldar and never returned."

subject: Magic Keys
text: You can restock on cheap Magic Keys in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Once in Rimuldar, notice that no one has anything new to say to you, but you should definitely restock on cheap Magic Keys here.

subject: Stones of Sunlight Chest
text: In Tantagel Castle, go behind the Magic Key salesman and around the river to reach the cellar, where an old man tells you to take the treasure chest containing the stones.

evidence.quote: Go back to Tantagel Castle, for now it's time to find the Stones of Sunlight. To get to this basement that the stones are in, open the door at the top of the castle, where you opened up all of the other areas of the castle. Go up to where the Magic Key salesman is, and the woman next to him. Carefully go around her and down, and then carefully around the river, and into the cellar. Talk to the old man there, and he'll say, "I have been waiting long for one such as thee. Take the Treasure Chest."...Open the treasure chest to receive the Staff of Rain.

subject: Garin's Grave Monsters
text: Monsters on the third and fourth floors of Garin's Grave include DrollMagi, Druinlords, Specters, and Wraith Knights.

evidence.quote: Fight monsters on the third and fourth floors, amongst them DrollMagi, Druinlords, Specters, and the dreaded Wraith Knights.

subject: Wraith Knights
text: Put Wraith Knights to sleep before fighting them, otherwise they will give you a hard time.

evidence.quote: Put the Wraith Knights to sleep and then fight 'em, otherwise they'll give you a pretty hard time.

subject: Golem
text: At the entrance gates of Cantlin, use the Fairy Flute to put the giant Golem to sleep and attack him with your sword.

evidence.quote: Enter the gates and be greeted by a huge Golem. Use the Fairy Flute to put him to sleep, and then hit the crap out of him with your sword. Welcome to Cantlin.

subject: Cantlin
text: The suggested level for reaching Cantlin is 15.

evidence.quote: SUGGESTED LEVEL – 15, although I was on 16. Ooooooh! =)

subject: Cantlin Inn
text: The inn in Cantlin costs 100 Gold.

evidence.quote: INN – 100 Gold

subject: Flame Sword
text: The Flame Sword is sold in Cantlin for 9800 Gold.

evidence.quote: Flame Sword – 9800 Gold

subject: Silver Shield
text: The Silver Shield is sold in Cantlin for 14800 Gold.

evidence.quote: Silver Shield – 14800 Gold

subject: Bamboo Pole
text: The Bamboo Pole is sold in Cantlin for 10 Gold.

evidence.quote: Bamboo Pole – 10 Gold

subject: Club
text: The Club is sold in Cantlin for 60 Gold.

evidence.quote: Club – 60 Gold

subject: Copper Sword
text: The Copper Sword is sold in Cantlin for 180 Gold.

evidence.quote: Copper Sword – 180 Gold

subject: Leather Armor
text: Leather Armor is sold in Cantlin for 70 Gold.

evidence.quote: Leather Armor – 70 Gold

subject: Chain Mail
text: Chain Mail is sold in Cantlin for 300 Gold.

evidence.quote: Chain Mail – 300 Gold

subject: Large Shield
text: The Large Shield is sold in Cantlin for 800 Gold.

evidence.quote: Large Shield – 800 Gold

subject: Herb
text: Herbs are sold in Cantlin for 24 Gold.

evidence.quote: Herb – 24 Gold

subject: Torch
text: Torches are sold in Cantlin for 8 Gold.

evidence.quote: Torch – 8 Gold

subject: Dragon's Scale
text: Dragon's Scales are sold in Cantlin for 20 Gold.

evidence.quote: Dragon's Scale – 20 Gold

subject: Wings
text: Wings are sold in Cantlin for 70 Gold.

evidence.quote: Wings – 70 Gold

subject: Fairy Water
text: Fairy Water is sold in Cantlin for 38 Gold.

evidence.quote: Fairy Water – 38 Gold

subject: Cantlin Equipment Shop
text: The shop selling the Flame Sword and Silver Shield is behind a locked magic door requiring a Magic Key to enter.

evidence.quote: Only one, and this one's behind a locked magic door which you'll need a Magic Key for. To get there, from the entrance of the town, go down to the first intersection, and then left. Open up the door, and buy any Magic Keys you need from the old man and the Flame Sword and Silver Shield from the guard behind the desk.

subject: Guard
text: A guard in Cantlin mentions that the last person to hold Erdrick's armor was a fellow named Wynn.

evidence.quote: Travel down a bit and talk the guard who'll say, "It is said that many have held Erdrick's armor. The last to have it was a fellow named Wynn."

subject: Old Man in Center Structure
text: An old man inside the large central structure in Cantlin says that to learn how proof may be obtained that your ancestor was Erdrick, you must see a man in town.

evidence.quote: Now, go to the large structure in the center of the town, enter at any angle. Talk to the old man in there who'll say, "To learn how proof may be obtained that thy ancestor was the great Erdrick, see a man in this very town."

subject: Wynn's Grandson
text: A fat man in the southwest corner building in Cantlin reveals that his grandfather Wynn once owned a shop on the east side of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: Go east of the large structure, using a key on one of the two doors of a building in the southwest corner of town. Talk to the fat man behind the counter and he'll say, "My grandfather Wynn once had a shop on the east side of Hauksness."

subject: Green Man
text: A green man walking south of the Cantlin inn reveals that Wynn buried something of great value at the foot of a tree behind his shop.

evidence.quote: South of the inn is a green man walking around who says, "Grandfather used to say that his friend, Wynn, had buried something of great value at the floor of a tree behind his shop."

subject: Axe Knight
text: Step on the swamp tree behind the vacant shop in Hauksness to fight an Axe Knight, casting Stopspell first to prevent him from putting you to sleep.

evidence.quote: When you see swamp ground towards the southwest area of the town, and a tree in the middle of it (near a vacant shop – rings a bell, no?), then go up to the swamp, and before stepping on the tree, heal yourself. Step on the tree to fight an Axe Knight. He can put you to sleep, so the first thing to do in the battle is cast Stopspell.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Searching the ground after defeating the Axe Knight in Hauksness yields Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: When he is defeated, search the ground you are standing on to find Erdrick's Armor. It equips itself automatically.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor provides the highest defense in the game, heals one HP for every step taken, and nullifies damage from special floors and swamps.

evidence.quote: It has the highest defense of any armor in the game (and combined with the Silver Shield you bought in Cantlin, you're set defensively), it heals one hit point for every step you take (instead of every few steps as with the Magic Armor), and those special floors and swamps that deal you damage no longer effect you at all.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Across the southern-most bridge south of Cantlin inside the swamp, search the ground at coordinates 70-40 from Tantegel Castle using Gwaelin's Love to find Erdrick's Token.

evidence.quote: On the way to Cantlin, as you're heading north to the topmost bridge that leads you to the city, go, instead, across the southern-most bridge there. You'll find a huge swamp...Use Gwaelin's Love to figure out your exact position on the map, you need to be 70-40 from Tantegel Castle. Once she says you are 70-40 from here, search the ground to find Erdrick's Token.

subject: Old Man in Cantlin
text: An old man behind a locked door on the south side of Cantlin's central building tells you to travel 70 leagues south and 40 east from Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: So go to Cantlin, and enter the large building in the center of town. Exit through the south and use one of your Magic Keys on one of the doors there, circle around, and talk to the old man. He says, "Let us wish the warrior well! May the light be thy strength! Thou may go and search. From Tantegel Castle travel 70 leagues to the south and 40 to the east."

subject: Old Man in Hideout
text: Cross the bridge south of Rimuldar, circle the mountains to enter the hideout, and talk to the old man to receive the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: Once you reach Rimuldar, keep heading south 'til you come to a bridge. Cross the bridge, circle around the mountains, and enter the hideout. Talk to the old man here who'll say, "Now the sun and rain shall meet and the Raindow Drop passes to thy keeping."

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: Using the Rainbow Drop at the tip of the peninsula northwest of Rimuldar creates a bridge leading to Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: Pick the Rainbow Drop in your items list and the screen will flash brilliant colors. A bridge will then appear. Cross the bridge and follow the linear path to Charlock Castle, home of the Dragonlord, but for the time being, home of Erdrick's Sword.

subject: Charlock Castle Throne
text: Inside Charlock Castle, follow the left path around to the throne and search behind it to reveal a secret passageway.

evidence.quote: Once inside you have two paths you can take. Take the left path. Take it around and you'll see a throne at the top of the screen. Walk up to it and go to the back of it. Search the back to discover a secret passageway. Enter the dungeon.

subject: Erdrick's Sword Chest
text: Deep in Charlock Castle's dungeon, go down a bit from a stairway, all the way left and down to a stairway, then right and up, avoiding the stairs to take the stairs to the left up, and follow the linear stairs down to a boxed-off room containing Erdrick's Sword.

evidence.quote: Go down a bit, and then all the way left, and down to the stairway. From here, go right and then up. Down go down the stairway, instead go back down to the left of where you just came up and go up the stairs here. Now, the rest of your path is linear, keep going up the stairs, and finally, down a flight of stairs to a small boxed-off room with the treasure chest containing Erdrick's Sword in it.

subject: Dragonlord Battle
text: You should be at least Level 20 before challenging Charlock and the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: Before challenging Charlock and the Dragonlord, you should be on AT LEAST level 20, preferably higher.

subject: Dragonlord's Chamber
text: From the stairs down from the second linear path in Charlock, head down and left at the intersection, down the stairs, up, right, down and left down the stairs to reach the courtyard outside path that leads to the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: Follow the first two linear paths we come across, the same ones we took when we got Erdrick's Sword. From here, head down and left at the immediate intersection, go all the way left, and then down, and go down the stairs. Go all the way up, then right, and go down, and go back left to the staircase. Go down it. Follow the outside path to the next staircase. Now you're in the courtyard and you can see the Dragonlord in a room to your right. Take the left path and go up and follow the paths around (don't bother with the treasure chests), and keep going around to the Dragonlord.
